purpose:
Draw the figure as TikZ using the measured pixel coordinates (origin top-left, y down; flip y for TikZ). Use one shared coordinate definition per point:
- O center (225.98,220.25); circle radius 157 p

result.summary: Version 1 of the TikZ figure compiled and passed validation (topology check passed, no missing edges). The automatic Critic scored it 0.93 with must_repair=false. It shows the circle centred at O with radius 157 px, chords AB, AE, EC and BD, and all six labels A, B, C, D, E, O. Coordinates come from the CV/Geometry Agent measurements, with y flipped for TikZ.
